title: 나열 -고 vs 순서 -아/어서
part: Aspecto y conexión básica — 상과 기본 연결
chapter: Coordinación y secuencia — 대등 연결과 순서
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The official NIKL guide distinguishes listing and sequence uses: **-고** can connect listed predicates, and both **-고** and **-아/어서** can mark sequence. They do not form a simple “-고 = list / -아/어서 = sequence” opposition; interpretation depends on the construction and context.
